dialogue_texts: Ugh... ouch... What was I... doing? My head feels like it's spinning...
Looks like you're back to your normal, clumsy self. The red aura's completely gone.
Now spill it - who did this to ya?
A lady... dressed in dark, elegant gothic clothes.
She came out of the shadows near Mayohiga and touched my letters...
Gothic clothes? Sounds like that Berenice culprit.
Messing with people's hearts is a dirty trick, even for an incident causer.
If she is active near Mayohiga...
We must move quickly before the infection spreads to more residents!
Heh, target acquired! Hold on tight, Shirogane-sama, 'cause we're heading straight for Mayohiga at full speed!
